{{Top}}
The '''sabacc pot''' was the grand prize reserved for the winner of the over all [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] match. This was unlike the [[Hand pot/Legends|hand pot]], which was collected at the beginning of each round and doled to the player with the best hand that round.
